stem: The scatterplot shows the amount of fertilizer \(x\), in kilograms per hectare, used on each of 8 wheat farms in Punjab and the wheat yield \(y\), in kilograms per hectare, of the farm. The line of best fit passes through the points \((20, 3{,}400)\) and \((60, 4{,}200)\). According to the line of best fit, what is the predicted yield, in kilograms per hectare, for a farm that uses no fertilizer?
solution: Slope: \(\frac{4{,}200 - 3{,}400}{60 - 20} = \frac{800}{40} = 20\) kilograms of yield per kilogram of fertilizer.
So the predicted yield with no fertilizer, the \(y\)-intercept, is 3,000 kilograms per hectare.

explanation.A: Correct. The slope is 20, so \(y = 20x + 3{,}000\), and the prediction at \(x = 0\) is 3,000.
explanation.B: Incorrect. This is the yield at \(x = 20\), a point on the line, not at \(x = 0\).
explanation.C: Incorrect. This moves the wrong way along the line: \(3{,}400 - 2(400)\). Going from \(x = 20\) to \(x = 0\) lowers \(y\) by \(20 \times 20 = 400\) only once.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This uses a slope of 10 instead of 20; the slope is \(\frac{800}{40} = 20\).

verify:
x = symbols('x')
m = Rational(4200 - 3400, 60 - 20)
line = sympify(figure['line'])
assert diff(line, x) == m and line.subs(x, 20) == 3400 and line.subs(x, 60) == 4200
b = line.subs(x, 0)
assert b == 3000
assert value(choices[answer]) == b
assert all(value(choices[k]) != b for k in choices if k != answer)
